description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siddamulla, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 510020 (24/0186)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances. The content focuses on land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land and property-related administrative matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
